bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Hourly Pay to Annual Salary

Whether you are comparing job offers, negotiating a raise, or curious about a public figure’s earnings such as the **alessandro circati salary**, the first step is understanding how an hourly rate translates into annual pay. In Australia, the standard full-time working week is 38 hours, and the typical year has 52 weeks. The formula is straightforward: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. For example, if you earn $30 per hour and work 38 hours each week, your annual gross pay is $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280.

Our [the timesheet](/) calculator lets you enter your base hourly rate and optionally add casual loading. It then shows your annual, monthly, fortnightly, and weekly pay before and after tax and super. The calculator assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. This gives you a clear baseline estimate.

### The 38-Hour Week and the Fortnight

Most full-time awards and the National Employment Standards define a full-time week as 38 hours. When you know your weekly pay, you can easily find your fortnightly pay by multiplying by two. For instance, a weekly gross of $1,140 becomes $2,280 per fortnight. Many employers pay fortnightly, so this figure is useful for budgeting. Our calculator includes a fortnightly column to help you plan.

### National Minimum Wage and Award Rates

From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours, according to the Fair Work Ombudsman. This is the legal minimum for employees not covered by an award or agreement. However, most workers are covered by a modern award that sets higher minimum rates for their industry and role. The Fair Work Ombudsman’s [pay guides](/blog) list these rates. For example, the Clerks Award has different pay levels depending on classification. Always check your applicable award to ensure you are being paid correctly.

### Casual Loading

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the minimum hourly rate to compensate for not receiving paid sick leave or annual leave. For the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate is $33.05 per hour. If you are casual, our calculator has a checkbox to add the 25% loading automatically. **Do not** enter a rate that already includes casual loading; let the tool add it for you. This ensures the super and tax calculations are based on the correct ordinary earnings.

### Tax and Medicare Levy

The Australian Taxation Office’s 2026–27 resident tax rates are:
- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

In addition, most residents pay a Medicare levy of 2% of taxable income. Our calculator uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed at the time of this guide. The estimate does not include the Medicare levy surcharge, HELP repayments, or salary packaging. For a more personalised calculation, consult the ATO or a tax professional.

### Superannuation Paid on Top

Employers must pay super guarantee contributions of 12% of your ordinary earnings into a super fund. This is paid **on top** of your salary, not deducted from it. For example, if your annual gross salary is $60,000, your employer contributes an additional $7,200 to super. The maximum contribution base is $270,830 per year, meaning super is not required on earnings above that cap. Our [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page explains how this affects your total remuneration.

### Using the Calculator for Any Salary, Including alessandro circati salary

Curious about the **alessandro circati salary**? While we do not have his exact contract details, you can use our calculator to estimate annual pay from any hourly rate. If you know his reported hourly wage, simply enter it into the tool, select the casual loading if applicable, and see the annual figure. The same method works for any worker—whether you are checking your own pay or comparing industry averages.

### Average Weekly Earnings Reference

The Australian Bureau of Statistics reports that full-time adult ordinary time earnings were $2,083.70 per week in May 2026. That equates to an annual salary of about $108,352.40. All employees total earnings (including part-time) averaged $1,579.20 per week. These figures help you see where your pay sits relative to the broader workforce.

### Important Disclaimer

Annual pay calculated here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

The results will show your gross pay, estimated tax, Medicare levy, and super. You can also explore our [reference tables](/data) for award rates and historical data.
